text: I feel a subtle curiosity waking in me as I step into this modern space. The glass walls and clean lines suggest order and clarity, yet the angles and reflections evoke a sense of ambiguity, reminding me that perception is seldom straightforward. The words and exhibits about research and development spark a gentle excitement in me—a reminder of humanity's ceaseless quest to understand and innovate. I sense a quiet anticipation, as though I am on the threshold of new ideas, ready to be discovered if only I pause and observe closely.
